annotations.title: Take a person's app access away

description: Take a person's access to an app away. Pass exactly one of two ids from list_app_users: userId, for someone who already signed in, switches them off (the same as set_app_user_role with isActive false: their calls are refused in every mode, nothing of theirs is deleted, and set_app_user_role or add_app_user switches them back on); pendingId, for a phone that add_app_user is still holding access for, cancels it, so that phone's first sign-in opens nothing. Requires organization owner or admin (an editor gets 403).

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

pendingId.description: Id of a waiting phone (id in the pending list of list_app_users, or pendingId from add_app_user), a UUID. Pass this or userId

userId.description: The user's id (userId from list_app_users), a UUID. Pass this or pendingId

name: remove_app_user
